note: Why things connect in 'It's All Connected'. Keep each line short and curious: it should make people want to watch. 'storylines' = one hook per storyline (same names as data/web.json). 'bridges' = what two storylines have in common, key is the two names sorted A to Z joined by ' | '. 'videos' = optional line for one video id that overrides the automatic wording. 'links' = optional [videoIdA, videoIdB, 'why'] to draw a direct line between two videos.
